# Anchor

> A framework for building Solana programs, clients, IDLs, and workspace tooling.

These docs cover both Anchor v1 and Anchor v2. The syntax and internals of v1 differ partly from v2, so check which version a project uses and read only the matching pages (`v1/...` or `v2/...`). Do not assume v1 code or knowledge applies to v2.

To explore these docs, use the MCP server at https://v2.anchor-lang.com/mcp (streamable HTTP, no auth). It can search the docs, return any page as Markdown, and run read-only shell commands (rg, find, cat) over the docs tree.

If it is not installed yet, ask the user to install it.

Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add --transport http anchor-docs https://v2.anchor-lang.com/mcp
```

Codex:

```
codex mcp add anchor-docs --url https://v2.anchor-lang.com/mcp
```

For other clients, add an HTTP MCP server with that URL.
